
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/axing/p/19940040" title="发布于 2026-04-27 20:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C# 视频录制监控系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　视频按需定制录制，是跨境电商和物流行业必不可少的一环，不仅可以针对不同包裹的打包或者作业记录，也可以随时观察流水线作业人员的操作是否符合规范！</p>
<p>　　<strong><span>整体架构以及功能分布</span></strong></p>
<p>　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195747969-428809602.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　&nbsp;本文是笔者以中间件-服务端的设计理念，开发的一套视频按需定制录制系统，支持跨域，自定义水印，授权使用等功能，通过API方式请求中间件，进而触发相机视频录制的流程，支持单相机和多相机视频录制，支持多相机视频合成等功能（其他功能可按客户需求扩展，相机只需要支持RTSP协议即可）。以下是软件运行截图：　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195818262-937161518.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195836590-759740014.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195857288-2093818184.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195845351-502124232.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;　　右键服务图标，支持查看当前运行日志，设置，认证信息，退出等操作。</span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;显示日志：实时显示外界API请求以及中间件处理相机视频录制，分割，任务打点记录，合成处理，上传，失败重传机制等一系列功能</span></p>
<p><span>　　</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195923969-1486724262.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;设置：配置单相机或者多相机录制，以及上传设置，磁盘管理，软件更新，多相机合成模式（画中画还是网格合并）等等</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427195946274-1548429510.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;画中画</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200003705-396141241.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;网格</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200015124-1513071617.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>授权管理：支持离线和在线授权两种方式</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200033391-1404988576.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span>API如何通讯？</span></strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200048942-657086400.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>该软件以Httplistener监听本地请求（支持跨域，以及外网请求，本文以局域网请求示例），接口设计主要分为三个接口（单/多相机相同入口）：</span></p>
<p><span>/Status：请求相机状态，心跳等&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>/Stop：打点记录，用于视频分割</span></p>
<p><span>/StopEnd：通知服务端开始异步视频分割，视频水印添加，视频按需合成，视频上传等等</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<strong><span>录制核心</span></strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200115980-1877035021.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;启动录制:</p>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">             }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigManager.CurrentConfig;

<p>停止点记录（用于视频分割）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>publicasync Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; StopRecordingAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> trackingNo, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> watermark)
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (_sessionLock)
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_currentSession == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">_currentSession.IsRecording)
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonConvert.SerializeObject(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">400</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">没有活跃的录制会话</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
         }
         _currentSession.AddStopPoint(trackingNo, watermark, DateTime.Now);
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonConvert.SerializeObject(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">停止点已记录</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
     }
 }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>作业完成：通知后台视频分开，水印，合成，上传：</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>publicasync Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; StopEndAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wave)
  {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _sessionSemaphore.WaitAsync();
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      {
          SessionRecorder session </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lock</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (_sessionLock)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_currentSession == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">_currentSession.IsRecording)
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonConvert.SerializeObject(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">400</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, message = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">没有活跃的录制会话</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
              session </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _currentSession;
              _currentSession </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          }
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> session.StopEnd(wave);
          CurrentState </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RecorderState.Idle;
          OnStatusChanged($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">录制会话已结束，波次：{wave ?? </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>超时<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 快速返回，无需额外延迟</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonConvert.SerializeObject(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result });
      }
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      {
          _sessionSemaphore.Release();
      }
  }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong data-brushtype="text"><span>授权机制</span></strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200231256-316325317.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>支持在线和离线授权两种方式，支持自动更新</span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;离线授权:根据私钥和公钥，对称加密方式生成license文件</span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;在线授权:心跳实时请求授权API，校验密钥和token的方式</span></p>
<p><span><strong><span>托盘UI</span></strong></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200258274-1367467268.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>软件启动，自动启动心跳循环检测，校验授权状态以及相机连接状态等等，更新服务托盘图标，显示展示授权和连接状态</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200310320-2017272341.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200337526-491053560.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/116076/202604/116076-20260427200330705-1066609564.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong data-brushtype="text"><span>结束语</span></strong></p>
